mapper.sql: SELECT d.department_id, d.tenant_id, d.parent_department_id, d.department_nm, d.manager_user_id, mu.user_nm AS manager_user_nm, d.department_dc, d.sort_order, d.use_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_department c WHERE c.parent_department_id = d.department_id AND c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.use_at = 'Y') AS child_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user u WHERE u.department_id = d.department_id AND u.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND u.use_at = 'Y' AND NOT (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE)) AS user_count, d.created_by, d.created_at, d.updated_by, d.updated_at FROM tb_department d LEFT JOIN tb_user mu ON mu.user_id = d.manager_user_id AND mu.tenant_id = d.tenant_id
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_department ( tenant_id, parent_department_id, department_nm, manager_user_id, department_dc, sort_order, use_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{parentDepartmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{departmentNm}, #{managerUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{departmentDc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder}, 'Y', #{createdBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) RETURNING department_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_department SET parent_department_id = #{parentDepartmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, department_nm = #{departmentNm}, manager_user_id = #{managerUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, department_dc = #{departmentDc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_by = #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, li.item_nm AS level_nm, la.login_code, u.mobile_no, u.email_addr, CASE WHEN d.manager_user_id = u.user_id THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS manager_yn,
FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id AND d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id AND la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item li ON li.common_code_item_id = u.level_id AND li.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND li.use_at = 'Y'
WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.department_id = #{departmentId} AND u.use_at = 'Y'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.manager_user_id = u.user_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.user_nm ASC, u.user_id ASC
SELECT tenant_nm FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{value}

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, li.item_nm AS level_nm, la.login_code, u.mobile_no, u.email_addr, 'N' AS manager_yn,
FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id AND la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item li ON li.common_code_item_id = u.level_id AND li.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND li.use_at = 'Y'
WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.department_id IS NULL AND u.use_at = 'Y'
ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC, u.user_id ASC
